name: invariants
description: Load-time invariants, one case each. Errors (`violations`): traj-uid-missing, nucleus-lyric-mismatch, anchor-missing, anchor-silence, anchor-order, unanchored-start, anchor-t, key-unknown, cluster-not-allowed, tone-not-allowed, nucleus-missing, final-unknown, syllabic-not-allowed, syllable-malformed (schema-invalid cases, `schemaInvalid: true`). Warnings (`warnings`): track-not-vocal. A client reports them; what it does next (refuse, repair, warn) is its own choice in 0.3.0.

cases.name: anchor-missing
cases.description: The anchor names no trajectory of this phrase; v1 then starts the track without a syllable.

cases.name: anchor-silence
cases.description: A syllable starts on a silence trajectory (id 12).

cases.name: anchor-order
cases.description: Syllables out of trajectory order.

cases.name: unanchored-after-silence
cases.description: v3 follows a silence but starts no syllable.

cases.name: anchor-t-nonzero
cases.description: anchor.t must be 0 in 0.3.x: no system allows a mid-trajectory onset yet.

cases.name: tone-in-hindi
cases.description: hindi-urdu defines no tones.

cases.name: cluster-in-hindi
cases.description: hindi-urdu does not allow onset clusters.

cases.name: unknown-key
cases.description: onset 'qa' is not a hindi-urdu key.

cases.name: syllabic-nasal-in-kurmanji
cases.description: Syllabic nasals (no nucleus, coda m|ng) are allowed only by a pack with syllabicNasals (jyutping).

cases.name: kurmanji-cluster-ok
cases.description: xwe: Kurmanji allows the onset cluster x+w.

cases.name: jyutping-bare-eo
cases.description: Bare eo is not among the 59 listed finals. It is a candidate for Yingyao's 60th final (unverified in packs/jyutping.json); if it is confirmed, this case becomes valid.

cases.name: jyutping-coda-cluster
cases.description: A coda cluster in a pack with a finals table: reported once, not a crash and not also final-unknown.

cases.name: traj-without-uniqueId
cases.description: A row-0 trajectory with no uniqueId cannot be anchored; loaders assign ids before healing, and heal/project/rehome refuse such a trajectory.

cases.name: nucleus-lyric-mismatch
cases.description: nucleus 'ā' with lyric.vowel 'ī'. Editors keep the two in sync (absent nucleus == null lyric.vowel); the projection reads lyric.vowel and IPA reads nucleus, so a mismatch is an error.

cases.name: track-not-vocal
cases.description: Track 0 is a Sitar but carries syllables: a warning, not an error (a sung bol or a mislabelled track). Vocal labels: 'Vocal (M)', 'Vocal (F)'. Track 1 is vocal with no syllables: nothing to report; tracks are independent.

cases.name: malformed-no-anchor
cases.description: An entry with no anchor. The schema rejects the document; a client that meets one from a buggy writer reports syllable-malformed, carries the entries through byte-identical, does not project that phrase, and the guard refuses an old client's save ('unreadable').

cases.name: malformed-null-entry
cases.description: A null entry. The schema rejects the document; a client that meets one from a buggy writer reports syllable-malformed, carries the entries through byte-identical, does not project that phrase, and the guard refuses an old client's save ('unreadable').

cases.name: malformed-not-array
cases.description: syllables is a string, not an array. The schema rejects the document; a client that meets one from a buggy writer reports syllable-malformed, carries the entries through byte-identical, does not project that phrase, and the guard refuses an old client's save ('unreadable').

cases.name: malformed-null-lyric
cases.description: lyric present but null. The schema rejects the document; a client that meets one from a buggy writer reports syllable-malformed, carries the entries through byte-identical, does not project that phrase, and the guard refuses an old client's save ('unreadable').

cases.name: kurmanji-decomposed-key-ok
cases.description: Onset stored decomposed (k + U+0331). Pack keys are NFC and lookups NFC-normalize the stored key, so it resolves to the pack's precomposed key; the stored bytes are never rewritten.

cases.name: jyutping-syllabic-ng-ok
cases.description: ng5 (五): a syllabic nasal, allowed by jyutping.
